problems_found: SECURITY (TLP downgrade): the shell added session flags AFTER the typed line, so argparse kept the session value. A typed `--tlp=red`, `--tl red`, `--mode=light` or `-d2` was silently replaced by the session's AMBER/passive/depth. A RED line therefore ran at AMBER and its values could go to third-party sources. The detection only matched the exact tokens '--tlp' and '--mode'.
The session TLP never reached `links` lines in the shell. `links` has `--tlp` and hides third-party links at RED (A2). Only scan/run/extract got session flags.
A typed bare line in the shell that starts with '-' was parsed as options instead of being treated as one input.

SECURITY (AR01): `config show` and `config set` printed proxy URLs raw. Verified: `proxy = 'http://bob:s3cret@proxy.example:3128'` was shown in clear. The same applied to proxy_light/proxy_active and to refusal texts that name the value.
SECURITY: `history` printed stored lines raw, and lines were stored with C0/C1 control characters. A pasted attacker-controlled ESC/OSC sequence could reach the analyst's terminal.
_red_line only recognised `--tlp red` and `--tlp=red`, so a RED line written as `--tl red` was kept in the history.
A2/AR17 gap: a passive `v3lum run --tlp clear` printed 'TLP lowered ... recorded in the case audit', but a passive run wrote no case, so nothing recorded the lowering.
A2 inheritance: the AR07 follow-up scan of picked personal identifiers reused the request TLP. If the case TLP had been raised (for example to RED), the follow-up ran at the lower TLP.

App.data_update (legacy v1) re-downloaded every DATASETS entry with rt.data.fetch(ttl=0). That skipped DataStore.update's SHA-256 pins and the review of changed active datasets, and it accepted names that are not registered.
`v3lum --tor modules` / `info` failed with a UserError when PySocks was missing, because the policy listing context built a full proxied Runtime even though a listing sends no request.
The extraction preview counted IOCs itself instead of using WP17's ExtractionResult.preview(). Its groups (wallets, phones, secrets) and low-confidence rule differed from `v3lum extract`.
`--tlp RED` and `--mode Light` were rejected by argparse because the choices are case-sensitive.
A weak test in test_cli_policy.py accepted exit code 0 or 1 for the LIGHT-raised-to-AMBER scan.

Add a keyword `http=None` to DataStore.fetch (and the fetch_text/json/lines wrappers) and forward it to `_download(..., http=http)`. In _download use `http = http if http is not None else self._dataset_http(reg, url)`. Registered datasets keep the reviewed datasets scope. (2) context.py line ~536: `self.data = runtime.data.scoped(http=self.http)`.
